plan.title: feat(dashboard): God View "Confluence" — the River × Spectrum Deck union visualizer (mockup + PRD)
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: The /god-view center canvas is an empty placeholder ('Agent scan moved to the Agents fleet view'). Two complete god-view concepts were built for it — The River (PAN-3441) and the Spectrum Deck (PAN-3443) — and the operator directed that the production surface be the SUM of both: every feature of both parents, one surface, named Confluence. A complete, working, operator-reviewed reference implementation exists at design/style-guide/mockups/god-view-confluence.html.
narratives.Proposal: Port the Confluence mockup engine verbatim into React modules under src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/GodView/confluence/: pure math into a tested model.ts, the union WebGL shader into aurora.ts, the 2D engine into RiverCanvas.tsx behind the GodViewConfluence composition root, the event simulator deleted and replaced by real data (useConfluenceData over the existing store + the PAN-800 hook-event stream carrying hookName), plus the HookBus rail, the hook telemetry trace BottomStrip, the enriched TopBar, feed↔orb linking, tooltip/help/fullscreen, and docs. No new npm dependencies; raw WebGL1 + Canvas 2D; the mockup is the spec and where prose and mockup disagree the mockup wins.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Sidebar/ActivityFeed internals unchanged beyond the FR-23 hover/click wiring
- The mockup's issue rail is NOT ported — click opens the real /issues/<id> drawer (D-3)
- Wiring any dark-fiber hook (the rail shows them; lighting them up is per-hook follow-up work)
- Any new server-side pipeline for beads/cost HUD stats — absent sources render '—' (D-13)
- Per-harness hook parity for non-Claude harnesses (their orbs spark on lifecycle beats only)
- Configurability of mockup constants (they ship verbatim, D-5)
- The viz observes and never acts on issues/agents
- Configurability for mobile/small viewports (desktop-first)
- The parents' Winamp spectrum analyzer and abstract oscilloscope (superseded by D-14's hook telemetry trace)
- Restarting or deploying the live dashboard (flywheel's job, D-8)

autoDecisions.summary: Hook inventory helper lives in packages/contracts (frontend-safe), with a drift-guard test asserting parity with OVERDECK_HOOK_REGISTRATIONS
autoDecisions.rationale: D-11 demands the wired/unwired split derive from the registration table, but src/lib/claude-hooks-registration.ts imports node 'path' and the frontend cannot import it; contracts is the repo's only sanctioned server↔frontend shared-code path, and the parity test makes drift fail CI rather than silently diverge.

autoDecisions.summary: New modules use the confluence/ directory and the data hook is named useConfluenceData (not the parent's useRiverData)
autoDecisions.rationale: PRD §6 renames the module directory to confluence/; naming the hook after the shipped surface keeps the codebase vocabulary consistent (D-15).

autoDecisions.summary: The parent's engine-port work item splits into aurora-shader and river-canvas items, and the smoke-test/docs item splits into separate test and docs items
autoDecisions.rationale: Tracer-bullet granularity rule: one focused change per item, each independently reviewable and mergeable; no behavior change versus the PRD (D-16).

autoDecisions.summary: requiresInspection:true on exactly three items (confluence-model, confluence-data, river-canvas), all inspectionDepth fast
autoDecisions.rationale: These are the foundation layers every other item consumes (pure math contract, data contract, effects-API contract); a wrong foundation there forces downstream rework (MIN-796 lesson). Everything else is a leaf or mechanically verifiable at typecheck/test time.

autoDecisions.summary: plan.metadata.sizeJustification set instead of splitting into sibling issues
autoDecisions.rationale: The plan touches >25 files but only 5 subsystems, and it is one inseparable visual surface: the operator-approved mockup is a single artifact, shipping a subset leaves the canvas half-rendered, and the repo's complete-features rule forbids partial delivery.

autoDecisions.summary: Workspace PRD copy patched at 6 spots where prose still described the pre-D-14 Winamp spectrum/oscilloscope
autoDecisions.rationale: D-14 (operator, 2026-08-01) replaced the bottom strip with the hook telemetry trace; stale references in §1, audit row 42, NFR-7, the §6 diagram, §7, and AC-18 would have sent the work agent building the superseded form.

metadata.sizeJustification: One inseparable visual surface: the deliverable is a verbatim React port of a single operator-approved reference mockup (design/style-guide/mockups/god-view-confluence.html) plus its data wiring. The file count exceeds 25 because the port is decomposed into thin, independently reviewable modules (model/aurora/canvas/choreography/tooltip/help/hook-bus/bottom-strip/tests/docs), but the subsystem count is 5 and no subset ships a working god view — the complete-features rule forbids partial delivery of a single surface.

confluence/model.ts — pure engine math + unit tests

expected_outputs: model tests exit green covering every enumerated case
metadata.parallelSafeReason: New pure module in a new directory; touches no existing file, so it cannot conflict with parallel items.

narrative.Action: Extract every DOM-free piece of the Confluence engine (reference: design/style-guide/mockups/god-view-confluence.html — the mockup is the spec) into src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/GodView/confluence/model.ts, converting const to export const and taking layout as parameters instead of referencing canvas state: (1) STAGES, STAGE_COLORS, ROLE_COLORS, PROJECT_RING, HOOKS with HOOK_KEYS; (2) hashStr, hexA, fmtAge, clamp, fmtTokens, pickWeighted; (3) LayoutRect + computeLayout(W,H) keeping every mockup constant (padX=26, riverTop=92, spectrumH=54, doldrumsH=64, shelfH=34); (4) OrbState active|shelf|stale|failed + classifyOrb(input, now) with precedence shelf > failed > stale(≥30 min) > active; (5) positionOrb verbatim (stale two-row spread, failed cluster left of portalX, shelf spread, active column jitter); (6) pickOrb + acquireRadius max(18,r*1.9) / dropRadius max(52,r*4.2); (7) toolToFamily (exact case-sensitive name match, unknown→lifecycle); (8) modelGlyph (sonnet→S, gpt→G, opus→O, fable→F, k3|kimi→K, empty→null, else '?'); (9) gradual frost-accrual math (frost 0..1 from idle time, full frost = sink to Doldrums); (10) trace math for WI bottom-strip: time→x mapping over the 60 s window, 2 px row bucketing that stacks coincident events, per-second aggregate buckets with autoscale floor 5, window pruning — all taking `now` explicitly.

items.title: model.ts contains every export enumerated in the Action (constants, helpers, computeLayout, classifyOrb, positionOrb, pickOrb/hysteresis, toolToFamily, modelGlyph, frost math, trace math) with no DOM or node imports

model.test.ts covers: layout constants at 1680×945; stale spread assigns distinct monotonic x and alternating rows for 8 orbs; failed orbs land left of portalX; classifyOrb precedence shelf>failed>stale>active; fmtAge boundaries 59→59m, 60→1h, 1440→1d, 34551→24d; toolToFamily maps Bash→tool_exec, Edit→tool_write, Read→tool_read, WebFetch→tool_web, Agent→tool_agent, Stop→lifecycle, unknown→lifecycle; modelGlyph maps all five families plus null/'?' cases; trace math maps window edges, stacks coincident events, applies autoscale floor 5, and prunes events older than 60 s
every time-dependent function accepts `now` as a parameter and the test file contains no real setTimeout waits
useConfluenceData — store selectors producing orbs, hook stream, and HUD meta

expected_outputs: data-hook tests exit green on a seeded store

narrative.Action: Create the React hook producing the RiverSnapshot-equivalent the renderer consumes (PRD §6/§7): useConfluenceOrbs() subscribes to agentsById + issues + review-status slices, groups agents by issueId, applies classifyOrb and the stage mapping (planning agent→PLAN; review agent/convoy→REVIEW; test agent→TEST; mergeStatus queued/merging/verifying or merged-pending-closeout→VERIFY; else WORK — if the store exposes a canonical per-issue stage, use it per D-2), attaches model glyph via modelGlyph and the broken flag from the existing workspace stack-health surface, and returns orbs stable-referenced by issue id (custom-equality memoization). useHookStream() reuses the store's existing domain-event handler (no second socket): filter agent.activity_changed, map to {agentId, issueId, tool, hookName, family, ts}, keep a 500-entry ring buffer, a 60 s eventTimes window → eventsPerMin + eventsPerSec, per-family specRates (bump +0.13, decay ×0.5 per 1.6 s), and global energy EMA (min(1, evm/110)). Map heartbeat kinds to micro-states per R-17: thinking_start/stop→thinkUntil, waiting_start/clear→waitUntil, compaction kinds→compactT, cost-event→spend. useConfluenceMeta(): mergesToday (from recentActivity since local midnight), tokensToday + costPerMin (existing cost selectors — read-only, NO new cost pipeline), mergeQ (count of mergeStatus queued/merging), conversations count (conv-* sessions), staleTotal, system health, and beads WIP/BLOCKED/READY ONLY if an existing store slice carries them — otherwise omit and render '—' (D-13/NFR-8 checkpoint: ship hidden, file a follow-up, never build a tracker pipeline).

items.title: Given a seeded Zustand store, the hook returns orbs classified per the PRD mapping (shelf with yieldReason, failed, stale ≥30 min, active) with correct stage, model glyph, broken flag, and stable object identity across no-op polls
a fixture of agent-min-839-review-security plus three siblings and the review parent produces a convoy of 5 satellites including synthesis

a scripted agent.activity_changed stream advances eventsPerMin within the 60 s window (vi.useFakeTimers + advanceTimersByTimeAsync), bumps per-family rates +0.13 with ×0.5/1.6 s decay, and preserves hookName on each entry
thinking/waiting/compaction/cost heartbeat kinds produces thinkUntil/waitUntil/compactT/spend micro-state fields, and an absent beads or cost source renders '—'/omission without throwing (NFR-8)
Verify the per-tool hook event stream reaches the frontend; fallback coalesced fanout

expected_outputs: fanout test exits green (or the checkpoint note records no server change was needed)

narrative.Action: Implementation checkpoint (record the outcome in the completion note): with the dashboard running, drive one agent through a tool-heavy turn and confirm agent.activity_changed events carrying tool — and hookName where the ingestion knows the firing script (R-8/R-15) — arrive in the frontend store at ≥5/s. If confirmed, this item ships NO server change. Fallback (only if throttled): in the heartbeat route (runtime-events.ts, R-11) emit a dedicated agent.tool_used {agentId, tool, hookName, ts} event alongside the existing activity write, rate-limited to 10/s/agent with a 1 s trailing-edge coalescer inside the existing async handler — never execSync, never a bare setTimeout without cleanup (NFR-3) — fanned out through the same domain-event bus; add a route-level test posting scripted heartbeats and asserting the coalesced fanout with vi.useFakeTimers. Either way, hookName must survive to the frontend event (the hook bus and trace channels key on it); when only tool is present the frontend counts the event once under PostToolUse and does NOT attempt Pre/Post pairing inference (PRD §7). Non-Claude harnesses emitting no tool stream must not break anything — their orbs spark on lifecycle beats only (H-4).

when the fallback ships, the route-level test emits scripted heartbeats and receives coalesced agent.tool_used events at ≤10/s/agent using fake timers, with hookName preserved end-to-end

RiverCanvas + GodViewConfluence composition root — the engine port

expected_outputs: typecheck and lint complete without errors

narrative.Action: Port the mockup engine VERBATIM into React (do not redesign; constants and draw order ship as-is, D-5). RiverCanvas.tsx: stacked gl (item aurora-shader) + fx canvases plus an offscreen trails canvas; state containers orbs/particles (cap 1600)/pulses/tickers (cap 6)/specRates; the frame(now) loop with dt=min(.05,…) and decay math, movement integration (bob/orbit/separation/shelf/stale/failed/merging branches) and particle/pulse/ticker integration verbatim; the draw pipeline in the mockup's exact order: trails fade+stamp → drawRiver (incl. the stage-gradient waveform ribbon on the river midline, amplitude = total event energy) → drawZones → drawPortal → drawSun → trails composite 'lighter' → drawConvoys → drawOrbs → drawParticles → drawPulses → drawTickers → drawTide → drawStageHeaders (with lane-header activity alpha pulse) → drawConstellation → drawSequencer (double rotating dashed rings). Orbs render role core + modelGlyph letter + project ring + heat-scaled size/glow; convoy satellites on CIRCULAR orbits (D-10) with S/C/P/R/Σ letters, verdict-flash arcs, and arrival spirals (36 px/s decay to base orbit); shelf orbs show ⏸ + yield reason; gradual frost accrual on quiet active orbs (desaturate, frost crown, snow) before sinking to the Doldrums; merge-queue dwell (bob 1.5–3.5 s + MERGE Q depth); wrecks blink by the portal; micro-states per FR-21 (waiting amber dashed rotating ring, thinking white inner arc, compacting contraction + orange ring, broken red hazard flicker + error sparks + tag, cost rising $ particles); warn stays a distinct static amber dashed ring. Expose the effects API as thin wrappers over the mockup particle functions: emitSparks, emitRing, emitTicker, playTide, playMerge, playThaw, pulseSun, spawnFromSun, gateFlash. Keep a Map<issueId, RenderOrb> reconciled with props each frame (new→spawnOrb, merged→playMerge then drop, otherwise fade 1 s then drop). GodViewConfluence.tsx is the composition root (stage-wrap structure, hint chip, hook bus rail, sidebar, bottom strip, key/mouse wiring) and index.tsx replaces the 'Agent scan moved' placeholder with it. resize() caps DPR ≤ 2, uses ResizeObserver, and re-anchors all orbs via positionOrb; rAF starts on mount and cancels on unmount.

useConfluenceChoreography — real event → effects dispatch, simulator deleted

narrative.Action: Translate live data changes into canvas effects, replacing every simulated behavior of the mockup. Rules (decisions made — do not re-litigate): hook event for issue X → emitSparks(X, family) + heat bump 0.06 + specRates[family] += 0.13 + 13% chance of '<id> · <tool>' ticker + 16% chance of feed-style ticker (mockup fireHookEvent constants); stage change between renders → ring + burst in the new stage color AND gateFlash at the crossed column boundary (FR-18); mergeStatus→merging → playMerge; →failed → wreck reclassify only (no extra animation); scheduler yield (yieldedByScheduler or pausedReason starting 'yield:') → playTide(yielded, beneficiary) where beneficiary = the governor-named issue if derivable, else the most recently admitted review orb, else none; shelf orb unpaused → green ring + burst + swim back to WORK; fresh hook event on a stale orb → playThaw; agent.created with role plan (flywheel dispatch) → pulseSun + spawnFromSun. NOTHING runs on a wall-clock timer — no nextTransition/nextTide/nextThaw; ambient motion is a pure function of simT (D-6). Test: a dispatch-table test feeding scripted event sequences to a mocked effects API, asserting each mapping above (fake timers for any debounce).

items.title: the dispatch-table test sends scripted hook/stage/merge/yield/resume/thaw/dispatch events and receives exactly the effects calls enumerated in the Action with the mockup's constants (heat +0.06, rate +0.13, 13%/16% ticker chances)

HookBus.tsx — 21-hook rail with live LEDs, counters, and dark fiber

narrative.Action: Build the left rail (FR-20) from the contracts hook inventory (item hook-inventory-contract) — never a hardcoded list in the component (D-11). Render all 21 rows in inventory order with the mockup's styling: wired rows show name + counter + LED; on each hook-stream event with a hookName, bump that row's counter and set the hot class for 420 ms (one setTimeout per row max, cleared on unmount). Unwired rows render dotted/dim with a '—' counter and never change; the dark-fiber footnote renders at the bottom. LED/counter updates are event-driven ONLY — zero per-frame DOM churn (NFR-7). Tests with a scripted stream and vi.useFakeTimers: counters increment on the correct rows; hot appears and clears at 420 ms; unwired rows never change; the rendered wired set equals the contracts helper output.

BottomStrip.tsx — hook telemetry trace + role-count box

narrative.Action: Port drawTrace/recordTrace from the mockup VERBATIM (D-14: the hook telemetry trace, not the parents' Winamp spectrum). One labeled channel per wired hook — same order/colors as the hook bus, derived from the same contracts inventory so rail and trace can never disagree — on a shared 60 s time axis with 10 s gridlines and a pulsing 'now' playhead at the right edge. Real event ticks bucketed at 2 px stack taller/brighter in bursts (alpha .45 + count·.22); each channel shows its per-window rate with zero-event channels dimmed (factor .38); the aggregate events/s band on top uses real per-second buckets with autoscale floor 5 and current + peak labels. Layout constants ship verbatim: gutter 128, aggregate band 22, axis 11. Events come from the hook stream by hookName, pruned to the 60 s window (explicit now — no timers in the math). Every mark is a real event: no decorative idle bands, no fake motion. The role-count box beside the trace renders from the store's role counts. Only the trace canvas redraws per frame (NFR-7).
